notes.title: Jumpers League is now in Early Access! Your Jump Starts Now.
notes.notes: [p]Hello, competitors![/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that [b]Jumpers League is now available in Early Access on Steam![/b][/p][p]The climb to become a legend starts now. This is the perfect time to jump into the arena, sharpen your skills, and help us build the ultimate version of this unforgiving multiplayer challenge.[/p][p][b]What to Expect from Jumpers League Early Access?[/b][/p][p]In this initial version, you can already experience the core of the competition:[/p][list][*][p][b]Challenging Online Multiplayer:[/b] Face other players in real-time in a vertical race to the top.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Total Jump Control:[/b] Master the mechanic of holding to charge and releasing to leap. Every jump is a critical decision.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strategic Abilities:[/b] Use powers to disrupt your opponents or to save yourself from a costly mistake. But be warned, reckless use can backfire![/p][/*][*][p][b]High-Stakes Gameplay:[/b] A single misstep can send you plummeting, losing valuable progress. The tension is constant![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Feedback is Our Climb![/b][/p][p]Early Access is an opportunity for us to build the game together with you, our community. We want to hear your thoughts on balancing, new ability ideas, game modes, and anything else that can make [i]Jumpers League[/i] even better.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your support. Now, stop reading and get jumping![/p][p]See you at the top (or on the way down)![/p][p]Best regards, The Little Manners Team[/p]
